গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকার
অর্থ মন্ত্রণালয়
অভ্যন্তরীণ সম্পদ বিভাগ
(কাস্টমস ও মূল্য সংযোজন কর)
প্রজ্ঞাপন
তারিখ: ১৪ আষাঢ়, ১৪২৯ বঙ্গাব্দ/ ২৮ জুন, ২০২২ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ

এস,আর,ও নং ২০৫-আইন/২০২২/১১৩/কাস্টমস।- Customs Act, 1969 (Act No. IV of 1969), অতঃপর উক্ত Act বলিয়া উল্লিখিত, এর section 19 এর sub-section (1) এবং মূল্য সংযোজন কর ও সম্পূরক শুল্ক আইন, ২০১২ (২০১২ সনের ৪৭ নং আইন) এর ধারা ১২৬ এর উপ-ধারা (১) এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে সরকার, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের সহিত পরামর্শক্রমে, জনস্বার্থে, ১ জুন, ২০২২ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ মোতাবেক ১৮ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৯ বঙ্গাব্দ তারিখে জারীকৃত প্রজ্ঞাপন এস,আর,ও নং ১১৯-আইন/২০২২/৬৭/কাস্টমস এর নিম্নরূপ সংশোধন করিল, যথা:-

উপরি-উক্ত প্রজ্ঞাপনের-

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act provides the government with the legal authority to issue and amend customs-related notifications in the public interest.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act grants the government the power, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, to issue or amend regulatory orders concerning tax matters.
National Board of Revenue: The board is empowered to be consulted by the government for the purpose of exercising delegated legislative authority under the Customs Act 1969 and the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012.
S.R.O. 119-AIN/2022: This specific statutory regulatory order, originally issued in June 2022, is subject to a formal amendment through the current legal instrument.

Code “2917.36.10” এর বিপরীতে কলাম (2) এ উল্লিখিত “Terephthalic acid imported by Industrial IRC holder VAT compliant PET chips manufacturing industry” শব্দগুলির পরিবর্তে “Terephthalic acid imported by Industrial IRC holder VAT compliant PVC/PET resin manufacturing industry” শব্দগুলি প্রতিস্থাপিত হইবে;

H.S. Code: The description for a specific H.S. Code listed in Table-1 is being amended to update the classification criteria for importers.
TABLE-1: This table contains the list of H.S. Codes and their corresponding industry-specific descriptions that are subject to regulatory amendments.
Manufacturing Industry: The eligibility criteria for the duty-free or concessional import of specific chemical inputs are expanded to include additional resin manufacturing sectors.

TABLE-2: This notification specifies amendments, additions, and removals of H.S. Code entries within Table-2 of the customs schedule.
The amendments adjust the descriptions of goods and industry eligibility criteria for various tariff classifications.
H.S. Code: Specific H.S. Codes related to industrial raw materials and components are amended, added, or removed to clarify industry-specific import concessions.
Changes involve updating the eligibility scope for industries such as tiles, sanitary, ceramic, tableware, petroleum, and cable clip manufacturing.
Industrial IRC Holder: The H.S. Code entries specifically define the scope for industrial importers who must also be VAT compliant to benefit from the stated concessions.
VAT Compliant: Eligibility for customs concessions under the modified H.S. Code entries is strictly limited to VAT compliant industrial establishments.

LED Lamp Manufacturing: Manufacturers of LED lamps are required to comply with the conditions specified in a separate customs notification to become eligible for the provided concessional benefits.
S.R.O. 109-AIN/2022: This regulatory order mandates specific conditions that must be fulfilled by manufacturers to avail of duty concessions on the import of materials.
Customs Concessions: The eligibility for specific duty or tax concessions is made conditional upon the adherence to requirements set out in the referenced statutory regulatory order.

Customs Notification: This notification is deemed to have come into force on a specific date in June, 2022.
